#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/sh
# Cretli managed autostart v1
export PATH='/home/user/node install/bin:/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin'
command -v termux-wake-lock >/dev/null 2>&1 && termux-wake-lock
cd '/home/user/my app' || exit 1
exec '/home/user/node install/bin/node' '/home/user/my app/scripts/cretli-supervisor.mjs'
warnings: Termux: no manager restarts the supervisor itself; SIGTERM to it stops supervision.
activation: Activation at next boot/login; use --apply --start to start explicitly.
